question: Which of the following states became the 17th state of the Indian Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Haryana became the 17th state of the Indian Union.
 
• It was formed on 1st November 1966.
 
• The state was carved out of the former state of East Punjab on linguistic lines.
 
• Its capital is Chandigarh, which is a **union territory and also the capital of Punjab**.
 
• Haryana surrounds Delhi on three sides, forming the northern, western, and southern borders of Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Haryana is known for its rich cultural heritage and history.
 
• The state plays a key role in the agriculture sector of India, being a leading producer of wheat and rice.
 
• It has a significant presence in the automotive, IT, and biotechnology industries.
 
• Haryana is also famous for its sports culture, producing many renowned athletes for India.
 
• The state's economy is one of the fastest-growing in India.
